title: Checkers: Event Horizon
tagline: Classic checkers — until the board starts fighting back.
description: Full American checkers with forced captures, multi-jump chains and a four-level alpha-beta AI that thinks off the main thread. Then flip on a creative mode: black holes that swallow anything beside them, tombstones that wall off lanes, telegraphed meteor strikes, or linked portals — every hazard is a real rule the AI plays around. Four hand-built themes, local two-player, undo, hints and auto-save.

modes.label: Normal
modes.desc: Classic American checkers: compulsory captures, finish every multi-jump, crown on the far row.

modes.label: Black Holes
modes.desc: Black holes form with a turn of warning; any piece ending a move on or beside one is swallowed.

modes.label: Graves
modes.desc: Captured pieces leave tombstones that block their square for a few full turns.

modes.label: Meteor Shower
modes.desc: Telegraphed meteors destroy whatever they hit and crater the square for 2 turns.

modes.label: Portals
modes.desc: End a move on one linked portal to step out of the other.

themes.label: Classic
themes.desc: Walnut & maple marquetry board, knurled turned-wood pieces with ivory inlay, gold-crowned stacked kings.

themes.label: Space
themes.desc: Hull-plate board adrift in a nebula beside a ringed gas giant; saucer pieces with chase lights and halo kings.

themes.label: Fantasy
themes.desc: Rune-carved altar stone lit by braziers; round war-shields with crowned kings.

themes.label: Neon
themes.desc: Synthwave grid and striped sun; holographic pucks with orbiting ring kings.

fablePass: Music: no score yet — needs a calm parlour/ambient bed per theme plus tension layers when a hazard is telegraphed (FABLE: music).
Black hole opening: gravitational-wave ripple across the board + sub-bass hit (main.js holeOpenAnim).
Spaghettification: true vertex-level tidal stretch along the infall spiral instead of an affine stretch (main.js suckAnim).
Capture: rigid-body tumble of the taken piece onto the side stack with a proper clack (main.js capture).
Coronation: light shaft, choir sting and slow-mo crown spin when a man is crowned (main.js promoteAnim).
Graves: a spectral ghost (cloth/face) curling out of a crumbling tombstone instead of particle wisps (fx.js GravesFX.fade).
Victory: bespoke celebration — pieces leap and spin, fireworks, music sting (main.js celebrate).
